entities.summary: Albin Theodor "Abbe" Jansson was a Swedish ice hockey player who competed in the 1920 Summer Olympics. In 1920, he was a member of the Swedish ice hockey team which finished fourth in the Summer Olympics tournament. He played one match as goaltender.
